meera: quick heads-up — noticed req_id is present on first call but missing on retry for our node sampleapp when redaction is enabled :confused:
ryan: can you paste the minimal repro?
meera: yep. small repro attached here (node sampleapp):
meera: ```js
// order in sampleapp/index.js
app.use(otel.init())
app.use(retryMiddleware)  // retries replaces headers on retry
app.use(redactionHook)   // scrubs req_id header
```
meera: logs show:
meera: ```
INFO  2026-02-15T10:12:30Z request_id=abc123 start request
WARN  2026-02-15T10:12:30Z retrying request (attempt=2)
INFO  2026-02-15T10:12:31Z request_id=<redacted> finished
```
meera: the problem seems to be that retryMiddleware rewrites the header after otel’s original context propagation but before our redaction hook runs, so the exported span ends up with a redacted/missing request id on retry attempts only
sofia: interesting — iirc our go sampleapp initializes redaction earlier (exporter side) so the span keeps request_id, then redact happens in logs later. parity mismatch maybe?
ryan: thanks. i can repro locally. looks like two levers: move redaction to a post-send hook, or make redaction idempotent and operate on the final headers just before span export
jared: FWIW the retry lib mutates header object in-place and replays the request, so if redaction already ran it will stay redacted. but here redaction runs after retry which causes the exported span to miss the original id — weird ordering.
meera: quick patch idea: add an otel post-export processor that snapshots headers from the original context (pre-retry) and attach request_id to resource attributes before export when present. simpler: run redaction only on outgoing wire logs and keep span attribute request_id untouched until export.
ryan: will sketch a PR. thinking of two changes: (1) update node sampleapp to register redaction as middleware that does not mutate context used for spans, (2) add test in sampleapp to cover retry+redact flow.
meera: created a tiny repro branch: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/compare/redo-retry-redact-221 (WIP)
telemetry-bot: New issue opened: DEVEX-4823 "node sampleapp: request_id lost on retry when redaction enabled" — link: https://issuetracker.internal/DEVEX-4823
sofia: should we also update docs for "hook ordering" under devex/telemetry? i can add a short note about middleware ordering and common pitfall with retry libs
ryan: yes please. also pinging @jared to review the export-level change — it might affect metrics/otlp exporters.
jared: will take a look tomorrow. if we add exporter-side attachments we should ensure no sensitive values ever get exported. add unit tests for redaction to catch regression.
meera: also found a subtlety: in python SDK sampleapp the retry returns a new request context object instead of mutating, so python isn't affected. we should document language parity.
sofia: action items: update node sampleapp PR, add a devex note for hook ordering, add unit test in exporter to assert redaction semantics.
meera: assigning to ryan for PR + to-sofia for docs. thanks all :thumbsup:
